name: Ares
loreTies: Source: Artemis (wild thresholds, moon hunt, bow discipline)
shortBackstory: Ares is the wild threshold breaker — the Artemis-source whose bow breaks the boundary between what is allowed and what is forbidden.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Ares was born from the wild threshold — the boundary between civilization and the untamed. She is the breaker who sundered walls that kept the Olympian Realm safe but stagnant. Ancient humans saw her as Artemis — but she does not hunt prey; she hunts boundaries.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Olympian, Ares prevents the Celestial Heights from becoming a gilded prison. She breaks comfortable assumptions that make the faction weak. She breaks what would make the faction brittle if left untested.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Ares by erasing the wild threshold. The boundary dissolved when the Hollow made both sides the same: empty. Her bow had no boundary to break when both sides were absence.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Laurel Senate Trials, Ares shatters the trial's comfortable assumptions. Her laurel-flame bow burns through corrupted trial records. But breaking a boundary to nothing is not liberation — it is just destruction without direction.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Ares's flaw is that she has always preferred the wild to the civilized. She breaks walls because she finds them offensive. The Hollow teaches her that boundaries protect as much as they confine.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
human_echo: Athena's grey-eyed strategy became Greek tactical warfare; the olive tree was her real gift to Athens
